newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices slip on cautious market.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices slip on cautious market.

text.p: Danish bond prices eased somewhat in opening trade on Wednesday, on a market seen generally treading water ahead of British uneployment data and U.S. consumer prices.
"We expect a relatively stable yield gap to Germany of around 75 to 77 basis points, and a fairly cautious market," a dealer said.
At 0715 GMT the seven percent state bond due 2007 was down 0.06 point from Tuesday's close, to 103.80, yielding 6.48 percent. The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed one basis point, to 75 bp.
